title: Jump, land and run dust; water and lava splashes
player_outcome: Landing kicks up dust in the colour of the ground, sprinting leaves little puffs, and jumping into or out of water or lava throws a splash ring with a splash sound.
design: Verified: landings/jumps only play audio (PlayerController.Sound.cs:27-29); _swimming flips silently (PlayerController.cs:134).

PlayerController gains events: Landed(float impactSpeed), Footstep, LiquidEntered(LiquidDef, float vy), LiquidExited(LiquidDef). The block under the feet comes from a new GroundBlock() helper (factored out of StepSound).

New game/Player/PlayerDust.cs (child of PlayerController) using EffectKit. Landing with impact > 8 → 8 chips in the ground block colour; jump → 4 dust puffs; Footstep while speed > 5.5 → 2 dust puffs; Dashed → 6.
Liquid edges: a 16-particle Splash ring in LiquidDef.Color plus Sfx 'splash' (volume by |vy|). Bobber landing splash comes from P3-11.
All counts scale with EffectsScale; no per-frame allocations.
files_modify: game/Player/PlayerController.cs — liquid edge and landing events; GroundBlock()
verification: Lavapipe screenshots: landing on grass/sand, a water entry splash
risks: PlayerController.cs overlaps P1/P3-25/P3-34; keep edits to small event hooks.
